situations.detail: We use 10 percent of the budget because the risk is low. Let's look at the results on Friday.

situations.de: Schlage vor, euch zuerst auf die besten Produkte zu konzentrieren.
situations.model: Let's focus on the best products first.
situations.detail: The top 20 products bring 70 percent of the sales. We'll look at the rest later.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr schon 80 Prozent des Monatsbudgets ausgegeben habt.
situations.model: We've spent 80 percent of the monthly budget.
situations.detail: There are still ten days left in the month. Let's slow down the daily spend.

situations.de: Schlage vor, etwas Budget für die letzte Woche aufzuheben.
situations.model: Let's save some budget for the last week.
situations.detail: Sales are usually higher at the end of the month. I'd keep about 2,000 euros.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr das Budget für schwache Produkte gekürzt habt.
situations.model: We've cut the budget for weak products.
situations.detail: We saved 400 euros this week. I'll move the money to the best sellers.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr die Verkäufe der Marke um 8 Prozent gesteigert habt.
situations.model: We've grown the brand's sales by 8 percent.
situations.detail: Most of the growth came from sponsored products. We'll keep this setup in May.

situations.de: Sag, dass die Verkäufe letzte Woche gefallen sind.
situations.model: Sales dropped by 5 percent last week.
situations.detail: One top product was out of stock on Tuesday. I'll check the stock levels tomorrow.

situations.de: Sag, dass die Kosten im März gestiegen sind.
situations.model: Costs rose by 10 percent in March.
situations.detail: The cost per click went up because of the spring sale. Let's lower the bids next week.

situations.de: Sag dem Kunden, dass ihr euer Quartalsziel erreicht habt.
situations.model: We've reached our target for the quarter.
situations.detail: We hit a ROAS of 5.2 on 28 March. Please see the full numbers in the report.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr die Deadline für die Banner verpasst habt.
situations.model: We've missed the deadline for the banners.
situations.detail: The agency was late because the images changed on Monday. We'll send them tomorrow at ten.

situations.de: Schlage vor, die Bestseller mit Sponsored Ads zu pushen.
situations.model: Let's push the best sellers with sponsored ads.
situations.detail: They have the highest margin, about 25 percent. I'll raise their bids on Monday.

situations.de: Sag, dass du den Call mit der Agentur übernimmst.
situations.model: I'll handle the call with the agency.
situations.detail: It's on Thursday at two. I'll send you a short summary afterwards.

situations.de: Sag dem Kunden, dass ihr das Tracking-Problem heute Morgen gelöst habt.
situations.model: We solved the tracking problem this morning.
situations.detail: The tag was missing on two pages. Please check the numbers again tomorrow.

situations.de: Bitte einen Kollegen, den Link in der Anzeige zu reparieren.
situations.model: Can you fix the link in the ad?
situations.detail: It goes to the old page. Please do it before the campaign starts at noon.

situations.de: Bitte den Kunden, das Ziel der Kampagne zu klären.
situations.model: Can you clarify the goal of the campaign?
situations.detail: Do you want more sales or more reach? We need to know by Friday because the budget depends on it.

situations.de: Sag, dass du die Daten heute Abend analysierst.
situations.model: I'll analyze the data tonight.
situations.detail: I want to compare the last three campaigns. I'll send you the findings tomorrow morning.

situations.de: Sag dem Kunden, dass du ihm am Freitag die Ergebnisse präsentierst.
situations.model: I'll present the results on Friday.
situations.detail: The presentation takes 20 minutes. Please send me your questions before the call.

situations.de: Sag dem Kunden, dass ihr einen Rabatt auf ausgewählte Produkte anbietet.
situations.model: We offer a discount on selected products.
situations.detail: It's 10 percent for the first two weeks of May. Please tell me if you want more products.

situations.de: Schlage vor, den Preis mit der Agentur zu verhandeln.
situations.model: Let's negotiate the price with the agency.
situations.detail: Their offer is 15 percent higher than last year. I'll ask for a better deal on Monday.

situations.de: Bitte den Kunden, den Vertrag bis Freitag zu unterschreiben.
situations.model: Can you sign the contract by Friday?
situations.detail: We can only book the ad space after that. I'll send the final version today.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr die Agentur am Monatsende bezahlt.
situations.model: We pay the agency at the end of the month.
situations.detail: The invoice is due within 30 days. I'll ask finance to check it this week.

situations.de: Sag dem Kunden, dass du ihm Ende Juni die Rechnung stellst.
situations.model: I'll invoice the client at the end of June.
situations.detail: The total is 12,000 euros. Please tell me the right invoice address.

situations.de: Bitte den Kunden, die E-Mail an sein Team weiterzuleiten.
situations.model: Can you forward the email to your team?
situations.detail: It has the new deadline in it. Please do it today because we start on Monday.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr den Report an die E-Mail angehängt habt.
situations.model: We've attached the report to the email.
situations.detail: It has 12 pages and a short summary on page one. Let's go through it on Thursday.

situations.de: Sag, dass du nach dem Meeting eine kurze Zusammenfassung schreibst.
situations.model: I'll write a short summary after the meeting.
situations.detail: It will have five bullet points. I'll send it to everybody by four.

situations.de: Bitte einen Kollegen, um 10 Uhr am Call teilzunehmen.
situations.model: Can you join the call at 10 a.m.?
situations.detail: The client wants to see the new dashboard. We'll start on time, so please don't be late.

situations.de: Frage, ob dich der Kunde jetzt gut hören kann.
situations.model: Can you hear me okay now?
situations.detail: I changed my headset because the sound was bad. If not, I'll call you on the phone.

situations.de: Sag dem Kunden, dass du seine Sorge wegen des Budgets verstehst.
situations.model: We understand your concern about the budget.
situations.detail: The costs went up by 10 percent this month. We'll send you a new plan by Wednesday.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr einen starken Anstieg bei den Klicks gesehen habt.
situations.model: We've seen a strong increase in clicks.
situations.detail: They went up by 25 percent since Monday. Let's keep the budget as it is.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr den Hauptgrund für den Rückgang kennt.
situations.model: We know the main reason for the drop.
situations.detail: The best product was out of stock for three days. I'll send you the stock report today.

situations.de: Schlage vor, ein neues Bild für das Banner auszuprobieren.
situations.model: Let's try a new image for the banner.
situations.detail: The old one has a low click rate of 0.4 percent. We'll test the new one for a week.

situations.de: Sag dem Kunden, dass ihr auf sein Feedback wartet.
situations.model: We're waiting for your feedback.
situations.detail: We can't start before you approve the banners. Please send it by Thursday.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr seit dem Kampagnenstart mehr Einheiten verkauft habt.
situations.model: We've sold more units since the start.
situations.detail: It's 1,200 units, which is 15 percent more than before. I'll add the details to the report.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr die Werbefläche beim Marktplatz einkauft.
situations.model: We buy the ad space from the marketplace.
situations.detail: We book it every month because the prices are better. Please check the new rates on Monday.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr jeden Tag auf die Top-Keywords bietet.
situations.model: We bid on the top keywords every day.
situations.detail: The average bid is 0.45 euros. I'll adjust it on Friday if the cost goes up.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr mit diesen Anzeigen junge Eltern ansprecht.
situations.model: We target young parents with these ads.
situations.detail: They buy a lot of baby products in spring. We'll test a second group next month.

situations.de: Sag, dass ihr auf Mobile etwas Sichtbarkeit verloren habt.
situations.model: We've lost some visibility on mobile.
situations.detail: Our share fell from 30 to 24 percent last week. I'll raise the mobile bids tomorrow.
